decision: Prioritize review, then complete the symbol graph
why: Large-diff review is the primary user task

decision: Git selection replays whole-file versions of selected commits
why: Patch-level replay of a subset is not representable with git apply alone

decision: Symbol graph reads types from SSA type objects, not Program.Blueprint
why: Blueprint holds only __GlobalVariables__ in yaklang Go frontend

decision: A* routing only for subgraphs <=90 edges, curves for the full graph
why: A* per edge on 1489 edges blocks the main thread
